title: Shards
summary: **Shards** are off-hand items that each give one effect while you hold them. Make them at `/craft` or win them from the Shard Crate.

blocks.p: Build any shard in the Shards section of `/craft`, or win one from the [Shard Crate](/wiki/smp/crates/). Some also come from the Reward Crate and the Vote Crate. Costs are on [Crafting and Upgrades](/wiki/smp/crafting/).
Hold a shard in your off hand to get its effect.

ul: {{icon:shard_of_strength}} After you swap the shard in your off hand, you wait 10 seconds before you can equip another.
{{icon:cluster_strength_vigor}} Two shards fuse into a Cluster, which gives both effects from one off-hand slot. See [Clusters and Prisms](/wiki/gear/clusters-and-prisms/).
Shards can be salvaged for Prism Shards at `/craft`.

history.text: The Shard of Vitality now gives room for 4 absorption hearts that fill over time, and the Shard of Vigor now gives Health Boost II.
The Shard of Healing and the Shard of Hunger now stop for 10 seconds after a player fight.
